youtube.title: Freeform Animation Rigging: Evolving the Animation Pipeline

sessions.title: Technical Artist Summit: Improving Productivity Through Art Tools UX in Game Development
sessions.title_zh: 通过美术工具 UX 提高生产力

summary.en: The session connects artist-centered interfaces, stability, and extensible architecture using examples from DCC software and game engines.
summary.zh: 结合 DCC 与游戏引擎案例，讨论美术工具如何兼顾面向使用者的界面、稳定性和可扩展架构。

sessions.title: The Audio Technology of 'Torchlight 3'
sessions.title_zh: 《火炬之光3》的音频技术

summary.en: The ARPG mix uses sound priorities, volumetric emitters, and screen-space attenuation to manage competing effects and maintain clarity.
summary.zh: 通过声音重要性混音、体积声源及屏幕空间衰减，协调动作 RPG 中大量同时发声的对象，保持音频层次清晰。

sessions.title: The Audio Technology of 'Torchlight 3' Part 2
sessions.title_zh: 《火炬之光3》的音频技术：第二部分

summary.en: The follow-up revisits mix prioritization and spatial techniques before examining the music system and timed ADSR envelopes.
summary.zh: 在回顾重要性混音与空间处理的基础上，进一步介绍音乐系统及具有时间控制的 ADSR 包络。

sessions.title: The Decoy Games Journey: From Gaming Brothers to Console Devs
sessions.title_zh: Decoy Games：从兄弟创业到主机发行

summary.en: Decoy Games recounts growing from a bedroom project to multiplatform self-publishing and shares lessons about console releases.
summary.zh: Decoy Games 回顾从卧室创业到 PC 与主机平台自主发行的经历，并分享准备主机版本时的经验。

sessions.title: The Early Days of Id Software: Programming Principles
sessions.title_zh: id Software 早期的编程原则

summary.en: John Romero revisits early id projects and the programming practices behind an evolving, continually shippable codebase.
summary.zh: John Romero 回顾 id Software 早期项目，介绍逐步形成的编程原则，以及维持代码持续可交付状态的实践。

sessions.title: The Narrative Innovation Showcase 2020: Mira Dorthe
sessions.title_zh: 叙事创新展示：《Tick Tock》的双人协作

summary.en: Mira Dorthe explains narrative and puzzle decisions that place communication and cooperation at the center of Tick Tock.
summary.zh: Mira Dorthe 介绍《Tick Tock》的叙事与谜题设计选择，说明如何把玩家交流和协作放在体验中心。

sessions.title: The Players You Didn't Plan For: How Jackbox Games has Adjusted to Life During Quarantine
sessions.title_zh: 意料之外的玩家：Jackbox 的隔离期适应

summary.en: Jackbox reflects on streaming audiences, remote social play, home education, and the production challenges of adapting during quarantine.
summary.zh: Jackbox 回顾直播观众、远程社交及居家教学等新用途，讨论隔离期间应对新玩家需求与远程制作的挑战。

sessions.title: The Revolutionary Future of Games: Interactive Streaming (Presented by Genvid Technologies, Inc.)
sessions.title_zh: 互动直播：让观众参与游戏

summary.en: Genvid and Deadhaus Sonata illustrate how interactive streaming can give viewers influence over the games they watch.
summary.zh: 结合 Genvid SDK 与《Deadhaus Sonata》，讨论互动直播如何让观众影响正在观看的游戏，从旁观转向参与。

sessions.title: The Sound of 'Anthem'
sessions.title_zh: 《圣歌》的声音

summary.en: Anthem's audio team connects its creative goals with implementation and dynamic mixing across movement, combat, creatures, music, and environments.
summary.zh: 《圣歌》音频团队从移动、战斗、生物、音乐与环境等方面，介绍创作目标如何落实为音频实现和动态混音。

sessions.title: The Year in Mobile Free-To-Play Games
sessions.title_zh: 移动免费游戏年度回顾

summary.en: The panel reviews notable mobile free-to-play releases, live-operation developments, and trends from the preceding year.
summary.zh: 回顾过去一年值得关注的移动免费游戏、新运营实践及市场趋势，延续该系列的年度讨论形式。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: From 0-1000: A Test Driven Approach to Tools Development
sessions.title_zh: 从零到千项测试：工具开发中的测试文化

summary.en: Playground Games explains building automated tool tests during Forza Horizon 4 expansions and sustaining confidence as features evolve.
summary.zh: Playground Games 分享《极限竞速：地平线4》扩展内容开发中的工具自动测试实践，讨论如何建立测试文化并维持开发信心。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: Geometry in Milliseconds: Real-Time Constructive Solid Geometry
sessions.title_zh: 实时构造实体几何

summary.en: The session presents a hierarchical CSG algorithm designed to handle thousands of primitives interactively, addressing scaling and robustness limitations.
summary.zh: 介绍面向交互操作的层级 CSG 算法，讨论大量基本体运算中的扩展性与稳定性问题。

sessions.title: Tools Summit: Writing Tools Faster: Design Decisions to Accelerate Tool Development
sessions.title_zh: 更快开发工具的架构选择

summary.en: The Machinery reduces tooling duplication through a smaller technology stack, a shared data model, and standardized reusable views.
summary.zh: The Machinery 通过精简技术栈、共享数据模型及标准化可复用视图，减少工具在撤销、保存等通用功能上的重复实现。

sessions.title: Towards Real-time Ray Tracing at Scale on CPU+GPU: The Present and Future of Intel oneAPI Rendering Toolkit for Digital Content Creation and Runtime Optimizations (Presented by Intel)
sessions.title_zh: Intel oneAPI：CPU 与 GPU 光线追踪工具

summary.en: Intel presents rendering libraries and optimization examples spanning interactive path tracing, denoising, large production assets, and game-engine integration.
summary.zh: Intel 介绍渲染库及优化案例，涉及交互式路径追踪、降噪、大型影视资产显示和游戏引擎中的应用。

sessions.title: Unity: Speeding up your Workflow for Mobile Apps & Games
sessions.title_zh: Unity：加快移动应用与游戏的工作流程

summary.en: JC Cimetiere's matching 2020 Unity session follows mobile development from prototyping to polishing using Device Simulator. The official discussion also points to safe-area testing and Adaptive Performance as parts of the workflow.
summary.zh: JC Cimetiere 的同主题 2020 年 Unity 讲座从原型到打磨介绍移动开发流程，涉及 Device Simulator；官方讨论也说明安全区域测试与 Adaptive Performance 在流程中的用途。

evidence.note: 采用 Unity 2020 年 Unite Now 同主题、同讲者的公开介绍，作为相关资料导读；尚未确认与 GDC Vault 录制版本相同。

sessions.title: Unity: Visual Effect Graph: Building Visual Effects in the Spaceship Demo
sessions.title_zh: Unity：用 Visual Effect Graph 构建 Spaceship Demo 的视觉特效

summary.en: Thomas Iche's matching 2020 Unity session examines connecting effects, lighting and sound through Timeline in the Spaceship Demo. It also covers scripts that make visual effects respond to gameplay.
summary.zh: Thomas Iche 的同名 2020 年 Unity 讲座拆解 Spaceship Demo 中特效、光照与声音在 Timeline 上的结合，并讨论让视觉特效响应玩法的脚本方法。

evidence.note: 采用 Unity Japan 对 2020 年 Unite Now 同名、同讲者讲座的公开介绍，作为相关资料导读；尚未确认与 GDC Vault 录制版本相同。

sessions.title: Until You Fall: Building Satisfying VR Combat on a Budget Part 2
sessions.title_zh: 《Until You Fall》：有限预算下的 VR 战斗

summary.en: The team examines feature prioritization and interaction trade-offs that preserved satisfying sword combat and presence within a small production budget.
summary.zh: 团队回顾小规模制作中的功能优先级与交互取舍，讨论如何保留令人满意的剑术战斗和 VR 临场感。

sessions.title: UX Summit: Microtalks
sessions.title_zh: UX 微演讲

summary.en: Short case studies cover text presentation, playtest feedback, Arabic interfaces, mobile adaptation, and the pacing of player information.
summary.zh: 通过短篇案例讨论文本呈现、测试反馈、阿拉伯语界面、移动端适配及向玩家传递信息的节奏。

sessions.title: Variable Rate Shading Tier 1 with DirectX12 from Theory to Practice (Presented by Intel)
sessions.title_zh: DirectX 12 一级可变速率着色实践

summary.en: Intel demonstrates Tier 1 VRS in forward and deferred rendering, examining integration choices and performance-versus-quality trade-offs.
summary.zh: Intel 演示在前向与延迟渲染中接入一级可变速率着色，并讨论不同实现选择下的性能与画质取舍。

sessions.title: Visual Effects Summit: Democratizing Real-Time Filmmaking Technologies for Indie Game Developers

summary.en: Independent developers examine access to real-time filmmaking techniques for cinematics and promotional content.
summary.zh: 独立开发者探讨将实时影视制作技术用于过场动画与宣传内容的方法。

youtube.title: Democratizing Real-Time Filmmaking Technologies for Indie Game Developers

sessions.title: What Does It Take to Catch a Cheater in 2020? (Presented by Denuvo by Irdeto)
sessions.title_zh: 2020 年反作弊技术与设计考量

summary.en: Denuvo examines cheat techniques and how hardware virtualization, platform roadmaps, and game-design choices affect multiplayer anti-cheat systems.
summary.zh: Denuvo 分析作弊技术，并讨论硬件虚拟化、平台发展及游戏设计选择如何影响多人游戏反作弊方案。

sessions.title: What Makes Us Tick: Inferring Players' Motivation from Gameplay Behavior to Foster Long-Term Engagement
sessions.title_zh: 从游戏行为推断玩家动机

summary.en: Ubisoft combines detailed play telemetry, motivation questionnaires, and preference learning to relate behavior to psychological experience.
summary.zh: Ubisoft 结合细粒度游玩遥测、动机问卷与偏好学习，研究游戏行为与玩家心理体验之间的联系。

sessions.title: What Online Games Can Learn from the Failures of Social Media
companies: ADL's Center for Technology and Society
tags: ADL's Center for Technology and Society
sessions.title_zh: 在线游戏能从社交媒体的失败中学到什么？

summary.en: ADL uses harassment research to discuss civil-rights perspectives and lessons for addressing hate and discrimination in online game communities.
summary.zh: ADL 结合骚扰调查，从公民权利与公平对待的角度，讨论在线游戏社区如何应对仇恨、歧视及骚扰。

sessions.title: What to Write So People Buy: Selling Your Game Without Feeling Sleazy
sessions.title_zh: 不让人反感的游戏销售文案

summary.en: Chris Zukowski introduces copywriting practices for explaining a game's appeal on storefronts without relying on pushy sales language.
summary.zh: Chris Zukowski 介绍游戏商店文案的基本方法，帮助开发者清楚表达游戏吸引力，减少令人反感的推销口吻。

sessions.title: Will You Marry Me?: Research from the Marriage System in NetEase Games
sessions.title_zh: 网易游戏婚姻系统研究

summary.en: NetEase compares in-game weddings with Chinese traditions and uses qualitative and quantitative research to examine player behavior and social effects.
summary.zh: 网易比较游戏婚礼与现实婚俗，并通过定性和定量研究，讨论婚姻系统对玩家行为及社交体验的影响。
